I don’t have real‑time access to weather services right now, so I’m unable to give you the exact current temperature in Moscow (in °C).  

For the most accurate and up‑to‑date reading, check one of the following:

| Source | How to use |
|--------|------------|
| **Weather.com** / **AccuWeather** | Search “Moscow” → click “Today” tab. |
| **Google Weather** | Type “current temperature in Moscow” into Google search bar. |
| **National Meteorological Service** | Visit the Russian Federal State Statistics Service website or the official Météo Russia portal. |
| **Smartphone app** | Use built‑in weather widgets or third‑party apps such as Dark Sky, Weather Underground, etc. |

These will display the present temperature in degrees Celsius along with humidity, wind speed, and other relevant details.
